name: Grow Beanstalk For Brainrots!
desc:
Grow Beanstalk For Brainrots 🌱

🎯 Capture a Brainrot before the giant gets to you!
🤑 Place it on your plot and upgrade, they'll help you get rich!
🌤️ Use your cash to grow your Beanstalk to help you climb to new clouds!
🧠 Capture new Brainrots to help grow your collection!

👍 Like, favourite and follow if you enjoyed the game!
